results.message: Found 1 duplicate mechanism signature(s) across 1 distinct location(s). Distinct fault paths can legitimately share a (detector, observable) signature on multi-round circuit-level DEMs (signature collision); if this DEM was assembled by concatenating sub-circuit DEMs, the same fault path may instead be double-counted. The decoder-facing probability for a shared signature is the XOR-folded value p_eff = p1*(1-p2) + p2*(1-p1) (iterated for 3+), shown per group in the counter-example.
results.hint: Hypothesis: mechanisms sharing a full signature in the same spatial boundary region suggest sub-circuit DEMs concatenated without XOR-merging; the correct probability is the XOR-fused value shown in the counter-example. On decompose_errors=True output, an undecomposed and a ^-decomposed instruction can also legitimately share a merged signature; groups marked '[mixed decomposition]' are distinct fault paths that collide only at the merged-signature granularity and are not true duplicates.
